title: System.Web.Mvc / System.Web.Http attributes do not exist in .NET 10 — replaced by Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc
notes: System.Web.Http (Web API 2) and System.Web.Mvc (MVC 5) are Framework-only assemblies that do not exist in .NET 10. Every using directive that references them is a compilation error. The rename is mostly mechanical: ApiController → ControllerBase with [ApiController], IHttpActionResult → IActionResult, [FromUri] → [FromQuery]/[FromRoute], Ok(x) / NotFound() / BadRequest(ModelState) → Results.Ok(x) / Results.NotFound() / ValidationProblem(ModelState). ModelState.IsValid can be removed entirely when [ApiController] is present — the framework auto-returns 400 on invalid models. The spec must record every route pattern exactly so attribute routing on ASP.NET Core can reproduce the same URL structure.
